thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: gpu-pool-us-west1 high queue growth detected (>1200 pending). autoscaler unable to acquire new GPUs; possible quota/limit hit. paging oncall.

pagerduty-bot: @morgan (oncall-sre) incident triggered: priority=P1, service=inference-serving-gpu, alert=gpu-pool-us-west1-queue-growth.

morgan (oncall-sre): Acked. looking.

kai (infra): I'm seeing a bunch of quota errors in the cluster autoscaler logs. posting tail of the autoscaler here:
```
W0425 15:02:11.345 kube-autoscaler.go:127] scaleup failed: cloudprovider quota exceeded: GCE: Insufficient resources available in zone 'us-west1-b' to fulfill request.
status: {"errors":[{"code":"QUOTA_EXCEEDED","message":"Insufficient 'accelerator' resources."}]}
```

ryan (platform): Confirmed via GCP console: per-project GPU quota for NVIDA_T4 in us-west1 at 0/8 remaining, regional quota is exhausted. Looks like other teams have spikes.

anna (eng-runtime): Queue size metric (inference-queue): 1300 pending, avg queue wait 38s, tail latency for high-priority routes rising to 4.6s. Impacting customer requests for realtime endpoints.

leah (support): Customer-success-bot just flagged 3 customers (enterprise tier) reporting slow responses and timeouts. They're seeing API 429/504 depending on retry.

morgan (oncall-sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) divert non-critical traffic away from GPU pool, 2) enable model-fallback to cpu-backed smaller model for best-effort requests, 3) manually scale up dedicated fallback pools if possible. I'll start with routing changes.

kai (infra): Working on route config. Reducing concurrency for hosted-gpu routes and adding header-based routing for premium customers to keep them on smaller pools.

anna (eng-runtime): Applying model-fallback policy now. patch:
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","policies":{"fallback_model":"redwood-small-cpu","priority":"best-effort"}}
```

morgan (oncall-sre): Also switching autoscaler mode to manual for the affected pools to stop repeated scale attempts flooding GCP. Command:
```bash
kubectl annotate deployment gpu-autoscaler controlled-by=manual --overwrite
kubectl scale deployment/gpu-nodes --replicas=0 -n infra --context=k8s-prod-us-west1
```

kai (infra): Done. Autoscaler attempts paused. We still need capacity for premium customers. ryan can we spin up reserved dedicated pool in us-west2 and route premium there?

ryan (platform): Yes. Provisioning dedicated T4 pool in us-west2 (reserved-capacity cluster). May take ~8-12 minutes to register. Meanwhile I'm enabling soft-fallback routing: premium -> us-west2-dedicated, others -> cpu-fallback.

customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers with incident number INC-2026-3040001234: short ETA and mitigation steps.

leah (support): Sent initial message to customers: "We're seeing regional GPU quota contention in us-west1; routing & model fallbacks applied to reduce impact. We're provisioning alternate capacity; will update in ~15m."

anna (eng-runtime): Observed immediate drop in high-priority queue for hosted-gpu routes after header routing: pending for premium down from 220 -> 30. Overall queue still ~900.

kai (infra): Attempting emergency quota request with GCP now. Raise request via support console and add priority escalation. copy of gcloud error: 
```bash
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=my-project | grep -i gpu
acceleratorLimit: 0
```

morgan (oncall-sre): I'm going to open support ticket and ping our TAM. Also, start a short-term token-throttling policy to limit per-API-key qps for best-effort endpoints to reduce pressure.

ryan (platform): Dedicated pool in us-west2 is almost ready, registering with control plane. when it shows healthy we'll shift premium routing fully.

anna (eng-runtime): Health checks green on us-west2 pool. Initiating route switch for premium.

kai (infra): Route update applied. premium traffic now draining to us-west2. Observed CPU/backpressure metrics: premium tail latency returns to normal (~120ms).

morgan (oncall-sre): Customer impact summary for incident log: - Affected region: GCP us-west1 - Symptom: autoscaler scale-up failed due to regional GPU quota exhaustion -> large queue growth and increased latency/timeouts for hosted GPU endpoints - Impacted: mix of realtime customers, some enterprise tiers saw degraded responses until routing + fallbacks applied - Mitigation: applied header-based routing, model-fallback to cpu for best-effort, manual autoscaler pause, provisioned dedicated pool in us-west2 and rerouted premium traffic - Next action: request permanent quota increase or redistribute long-term pool footprints, run after-action to avoid single-region contention.

leah (support): Adding note to customer updates: We're prioritizing your traffic to alternate capacity and will follow up with a post-incident writeup.

kai (infra): GCP support replied: "project quota exhausted, we can increase regional GPU quota but require justification and 2-4 business days for a permanent increase; we can temporarily raise for 24-72 hours if approved." I've sent justification form.

morgan (oncall-sre): Fine. For now we need a durable mitigation: 1) schedule redistribution of some production pools to us-west2 and us-central, 2) add quota monitoring + early alert at 60% utilization (not 90), 3) enforce soft quotas per-team to avoid cross-account consumption. Will add to postmortem action items.

anna (eng-runtime): Also enabling KV cache for repeated prompt patterns to reduce token generation load for some routes — should help token-level cost and throughput.

ryan (platform): FYI we saw a secondary issue: some lower-priority batch jobs were still targeting GPU pool. I've moved those to a separate queue that prefers CPU.

morgan (oncall-sre): Handing off to next oncall in 30m. @kai please keep the ticket with GCP open and update slack. @leah keep customers updated every 30m until resolved. Creating postmortem draft after stable.

kai (infra): Acknowledge. will keep watch and escalate to TAM if temporary increase not approved within 1hr.

leah (support): Will send follow-ups. customers quoted reduced latency for premium after reroute, but best-effort still degraded — noted.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" at 15:30 UTC. Next update scheduled at 16:00 UTC.

morgan (oncall-sre): Closing the pager for now but marking this P1 for a postmortem. Thanks all.

customer-success-bot: Logged customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported degraded experience; 12 smaller customers saw intermittent 429s. Will attach to postmortem.

anna (eng-runtime): Adding performance graphs and sample logs to the postmortem doc.

morgan (oncall-sre): Handoff note to next oncall (@kai): monitor quota request status, ensure dedicated pools stay healthy, and be prepared to expand us-west2 capacity if required.

kai (infra): Got it.
